anchors.exact_quote: Sufficient corrosion protection is achieved by adding the antifreeze additives listed under Permitted coolant additives, Page 316, whereby the prescribed minimum concentration must be observed. This concentration prevents freez- ing at temperatures as low as -22°C and ensures adequate corrosion protec- tion. However, the amount of antifreeze actually required always depends on the lowest temperatures to be expected at the place of use.
anchors.candidate_span: 冷却液应通过添加厂家许可的防冻添加剂获得足够的腐蚀防护，且应遵守规定的最低浓度；该最低浓度可防止低至-22°C的冻结并确保足够的腐蚀防护，实际所需防冻剂量取决于使用地点的最低预期温度。
